worship.title: Music
worship.subtitle: The language of the soul expressed through melody and rhythm to connect with the divine and build community.

piano.name: Piano
piano.long_desc: The quintessential harmonic instrument in worship. It allows playing melodies, chords, and bass lines simultaneously, sustaining the complete harmonic structure of a song. From soft accompaniments to complex arrangements, the piano offers a wide dynamic range that adapts to every moment of the service. Learning piano for worship develops harmonic ear, music reading, and sensitivity to accompany the congregation.

guitar.name: Guitar
guitar.long_desc: One of the most versatile and accessible instruments in worship. With six strings and a universe of chords, the guitar can create intimate atmospheres with soft arpeggios to high-energy moments with powerful strumming. It is the ideal instrument for leading worship due to its portability and ability to accompany singing. Mastering it involves learning chord progressions, rhythms, and fingerpicking techniques that enrich every song.

drums.name: Drums
drums.long_desc: The rhythmic heart of the worship team. Drums set the tempo, define dynamics, and guide transitions between song sections. In the worship context, playing drums requires sensitivity to know when to drive the energy and when to create space with subtle patterns. From contemplative ballads to celebration moments, drums sustain the foundation upon which the entire band builds.

kinesthetic.title: Sport
kinesthetic.subtitle: The expression of the body in motion, where discipline and training combine to push physical and mental limits.

workout.name: Calisthenics
workout.long_desc: Physical training focused on building strength, endurance, and overall fitness through structured exercise routines. From bodyweight calisthenics to weighted exercises, workout disciplines develop muscle, cardiovascular capacity, and mental resilience. It is the foundation of athletic performance and a path to pushing physical and mental limits.

swimming.name: Swimming
swimming.long_desc: An aquatic discipline that combines technique, endurance, and efficiency in the water. It covers the four competitive strokes: freestyle, backstroke, butterfly, and breaststroke, each with its specific mechanics of arm stroke, kick, and breathing. Swimming develops cardiovascular capacity, strengthens the body holistically, and teaches fluid movement in water. It is one of the most complete sports that exist.

football.name: Football
football.long_desc: The art of manipulating a ball with creativity and skill using any part of the body except the hands. It combines control, balance, and body expression in trick sequences that defy gravity. From basic foot juggling to complex aerial combinations, football freestyle develops coordination, patience, and personal style. It is a discipline that can be practiced anywhere, transforming a simple ball into an instrument of expression.
